# 1. Packages
```{r}
library(compositions)
library(ape)
library(phytools)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)  
library(geometry)  
```

# 2. Read and check data
```{r}
raw_df <- read.csv(file="./AllGymnoData_with_taxonomy_info.csv", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gymno.tree <- read.tree(file="./gymnoTree_final.tre")

data_meta <- raw_df[, 1:4] 
colnames(data_meta) <- c("Species", "Class", "Order", "Family")
rownames(data_meta) <- data_meta$Species 
data_voc <- raw_df[, 5:ncol(raw_df)]
rownames(data_voc) <- data_meta$Species
name.check(gymno.tree, data_voc)
data_voc[] <- lapply(data_voc, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
data_voc[is.na(data_voc)] <- 0
```

# 3. Define functions
## 3.1. penalized PCA function
```{r}
run_penalized_pca <- function(dat_matrix, tree) {
  dat_clean <- dat_matrix
  min_val <- min(dat_clean[dat_clean > 0], na.rm=TRUE)
  dat_clean[dat_clean == 0] <- min_val / 2
  
  dat_comp <- acomp(dat_clean)
  dat_clr <- as.matrix(clr(dat_comp))
  
  fit <- fit_t_pl(Y = dat_clr, tree = tree, model = "BM", method = "RidgeArch", targM = "unitVariance")
  pca <- phyl.pca_pl(fit, Y = dat_clr, tree = tree)
  
  return(pca)
}
```

## 3.2. Matrix perturbation function
```{r}
perturb_matrix_mixed <- function(data_matrix, base_sd = 0.05, prop_rate = 0.15) {
  mat <- as.matrix(data_matrix)
  sd_matrix <- base_sd + (mat * prop_rate)
  noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow(mat)*ncol(mat), 0, sd_matrix), nrow(mat), ncol(mat))
  mat_pert <- abs(mat + noise)
  row_sums <- rowSums(mat_pert)
  row_sums[row_sums == 0] <- 1
  return(as.data.frame(sweep(mat_pert, 1, row_sums, "/") * 100))
}
```

# 4. Run PCA
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Step A: Running PCA on Original Matrix
# ==============================================================================
original_pca_res <- run_penalized_pca(data_voc, gymno.tree)
original_scores <- original_pca_res$scores[, 1:2] 

df_orig_points <- as.data.frame(original_scores)
colnames(df_orig_points) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
df_orig_points$Family <- data_meta$Family
df_orig_points$Species <- rownames(df_orig_points)

# 筛选物种数 >= 4 的 Family
target_families <- df_orig_points %>% count(Family) %>% filter(n >= 4) %>% pull(Family)
df_orig_points <- df_orig_points %>% filter(Family %in% target_families)

# ==============================================================================
# Step B: perturbation -> PCA -> align -> record centriod)
# ==============================================================================
n_sims <- 20
noise_base <- 0.1
noise_prop <- 0.2

sim_centroids_list <- list()

set.seed(42)

for(k in 1:n_sims) {
  cat(paste0(k, ".."))

  sim_dat <- perturb_matrix_mixed(data_voc, base_sd=noise_base, prop_rate=noise_prop)
  
  try({
    sim_pca_res <- run_penalized_pca(sim_dat, gymno.tree)
    sim_scores_raw <- sim_pca_res$scores[, 1:2]
    
    # Procrustes
    proc_res <- procrustes(X = original_scores, Y = sim_scores_raw, scale = FALSE, symmetric = FALSE)
    sim_scores_aligned <- proc_res$Yrot
    
    # calculate centriod
    df_sim <- as.data.frame(sim_scores_aligned)
    colnames(df_sim) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
    df_sim$Family <- data_meta$Family
    
    centroids <- df_sim %>%
      filter(Family %in% target_families) %>%
      group_by(Family) %>%
      summarise(C_PC1 = mean(PC1), C_PC2 = mean(PC2)) %>%
      mutate(Sim = k)
    
    sim_centroids_list[[k]] <- centroids
    
  }, silent = TRUE)
}
cat("\nDone.\n")

df_sim_centroids <- do.call(rbind, sim_centroids_list)

# ==============================================================================
# Original Hulls vs Centroid Hulls
# ==============================================================================

# Biological Range
hull_orig <- df_orig_points %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  slice(chull(PC1, PC2))

# B. Uncertainty Range
hull_sim_centroids <- df_sim_centroids %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    if(nrow(.x) >= 3) {
      slice(.x, chull(C_PC1, C_PC2))
    } else {
      .x 
    }
  })
```


```{r}
p_combined <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_orig_points, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2), 
             color = "grey50", size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_polygon(data = hull_orig, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2), 
               fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.15, color = "grey40", linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(data = df_sim_centroids, aes(x = C_PC1, y = C_PC2), 
             color = "#458B00", size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_polygon(data = hull_sim_centroids, aes(x = C_PC1, y = C_PC2), 
               fill = "#458B00", alpha = 0.1, color = "#458B00", linetype = "dashed") +

  facet_wrap(~Family, scales = "fixed") + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_combined)

# ggsave("Family_Perturbation_Overview.pdf", p_combined, width = 14, height = 8)
```



## test if perturbation has effect on pulsed models
```{r}
library(ape)
library(geiger)
library(pulsR)

library(future)
library(doFuture)
library(foreach)
library(progressr)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```


```{r}
registerDoFuture()

set.seed(20260511)

num_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 2)
cat("Using", num_cores, "cores\n")

plan(multisession, workers = num_cores)

options(progressr.enable = TRUE)
handlers("txtprogressbar")

gymno.tree <- read.tree("gymnoTree_final.tre")

gymno.data <- read.csv(
  "AllGymnoData.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

gymno.data[] <- lapply(gymno.data, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

compound_columns <- colnames(gymno.data)

# Optional but recommended: ensure tree and data use the same species
common_taxa <- intersect(gymno.tree$tip.label, rownames(gymno.data))

if (length(common_taxa) < length(gymno.tree$tip.label)) {
  gymno.tree <- drop.tip(gymno.tree, setdiff(gymno.tree$tip.label, common_taxa))
}

gymno.data <- gymno.data[gymno.tree$tip.label, , drop = FALSE]

compound_columns <- colnames(gymno.data)

models <- c(
  "BM", "OU", "EB",
  "JN", "NIG", "VG",
  "BMJN", "BMNIG", "BMVG"
)

results_dir <- "aic_results_per_compound_perturbed"
log_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "logs")

dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(log_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

make_safe_name <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(x, to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT", sub = "")
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_+|_+$", "", x)

  if (is.na(x) || nchar(x) == 0) {
    x <- "compound"
  }

  substr(x, 1, 80)
}

safe_keys <- make.unique(
  sprintf(
    "%04d_%s",
    seq_along(compound_columns),
    vapply(compound_columns, make_safe_name, character(1))
  )
)

get_rds_path <- function(k) {
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("aic_", safe_keys[k], ".rds"))
}

get_log_path <- function(k) {
  file.path(log_dir, paste0("log_", safe_keys[k], ".txt"))
}

all_files <- list.files(results_dir, pattern = "^aic_.*\\.rds$")
completed_keys <- gsub("^aic_|\\.rds$", "", all_files)

to_process_idx <- which(!(safe_keys %in% completed_keys))

cat("Total compounds:", length(compound_columns), "\n")
cat("Already completed:", length(compound_columns) - length(to_process_idx), "\n")
cat("Remaining to process:", length(to_process_idx), "\n")

# Add random perturbation to 30% of zero entries in one compound vector
perturb_trait <- function(x, prop_zero = 0.3, min_add = 0, max_add = 0.1) {
  zero_idx <- which(!is.na(x) & x == 0)

  n_zero <- length(zero_idx)
  n_pick <- floor(n_zero * prop_zero)

  picked_idx <- integer(0)
  additions <- numeric(0)

  if (n_pick > 0) {
    picked_idx <- sample(zero_idx, size = n_pick, replace = FALSE)
    additions <- runif(n_pick, min = min_add, max = max_add)

    x[picked_idx] <- x[picked_idx] + additions
  }

  list(
    trait = x,
    zero_n = n_zero,
    perturbed_n = n_pick,
    perturbed_idx = picked_idx,
    additions = additions
  )
}

# Calculate AIC weights manually
# Failed models are excluded from AIC-weight calculation,
# and their final weights remain 0.
calc_aic_weights <- function(aic_values) {
  out <- setNames(rep(0, length(aic_values)), names(aic_values))

  valid <- is.finite(aic_values)

  if (!any(valid)) {
    return(out)
  }

  aic_valid <- aic_values[valid]
  delta <- aic_valid - min(aic_valid)
  w <- exp(-0.5 * delta)
  w <- w / sum(w)

  out[names(w)] <- w

  out
}

if (length(to_process_idx) > 0) {

  with_progress({

    p <- progressor(
      steps = length(to_process_idx) * length(models)
    )

    results_dummy <- foreach(
      k = to_process_idx,
      .combine = c,
      .errorhandling = "pass",
      .options.future = list(
        seed = TRUE,
        packages = c("ape", "geiger", "pulsR")
      )
    ) %dofuture% {

      compound <- compound_columns[k]

      # Compound-specific seed for reproducibility even after resuming
      set.seed(20260511 + k)

      save_path <- get_rds_path(k)
      log_path <- get_log_path(k)

      report_message <- function(txt) {
        line <- sprintf(
          "[%s] %s",
          format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
          txt
        )

        cat(line, "\n")
        write(line, file = log_path, append = TRUE)
        p(txt)
      }

      report_message(
        sprintf(
          "START compound %s",
          compound
        )
      )

      trait_raw <- gymno.data[, compound]
      names(trait_raw) <- rownames(gymno.data)

      perturb_out <- perturb_trait(
        trait_raw,
        prop_zero = 0.5,
        min_add = 0.1,
        max_add = 0.5
      )

      trait_data <- perturb_out$trait
      names(trait_data) <- rownames(gymno.data)

      report_message(
        sprintf(
          "Compound %s: zero entries = %d; perturbed zero entries = %d",
          compound,
          perturb_out$zero_n,
          perturb_out$perturbed_n
        )
      )

      aic_values <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(models)), models)
      success <- setNames(rep(FALSE, length(models)), models)
      error_message <- setNames(rep(NA_character_, length(models)), models)

      for (model in models) {

        fit_result <- tryCatch({

          fit <- fit_reml_levy(
            gymno.tree,
            trait_data,
            model = model
          )

          aic_now <- fit$AIC

          if (length(aic_now) != 1 || !is.finite(aic_now)) {
            stop("Model returned non-finite AIC")
          }

          list(
            ok = TRUE,
            aic = as.numeric(aic_now),
            error = NA_character_
          )

        }, error = function(e) {

          list(
            ok = FALSE,
            aic = NA_real_,
            error = conditionMessage(e)
          )

        })

        if (fit_result$ok) {

          aic_values[model] <- fit_result$aic
          success[model] <- TRUE

          report_message(
            sprintf(
              "DONE compound %s | model %s | SUCCESS | AIC = %.4f",
              compound,
              model,
              fit_result$aic
            )
          )

        } else {

          success[model] <- FALSE
          error_message[model] <- fit_result$error

          report_message(
            sprintf(
              "DONE compound %s | model %s | FAILED | final weight set to 0 | error: %s",
              compound,
              model,
              fit_result$error
            )
          )

        }
      }

      aic_weights <- calc_aic_weights(aic_values)

      result_object <- list(
        compound = compound,
        compound_index = k,
        safe_key = safe_keys[k],
        aic = aic_values,
        weights = aic_weights,
        success = success,
        error_message = error_message,
        perturbation = list(
          zero_n = perturb_out$zero_n,
          perturbed_n = perturb_out$perturbed_n,
          perturbed_species = names(trait_raw)[perturb_out$perturbed_idx],
          additions = perturb_out$additions
        )
      )

      saveRDS(result_object, save_path)

      report_message(
        sprintf(
          "FINISHED compound %s | result saved to %s",
          compound,
          save_path
        )
      )

      TRUE
    }
  })

  cat("Parallel processing finished.\n")

} else {

  cat("No new compounds to process.\n")
}

plan(sequential)

cat("Merging all perturbed results...\n")

processed_files <- list.files(
  results_dir,
  pattern = "^aic_.*\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

aic_weights_list <- list()
aic_values_list <- list()
status_list <- list()

for (f in processed_files) {

  obj <- readRDS(f)

  if (is.null(obj$weights)) {
    next
  }

  compound <- obj$compound

  aic_weights_list[[compound]] <- obj$weights
  aic_values_list[[compound]] <- obj$aic

  status_list[[compound]] <- data.frame(
    Compound = compound,
    Model = names(obj$weights),
    AIC = as.numeric(obj$aic),
    AIC_weight = as.numeric(obj$weights),
    Success = as.logical(obj$success),
    Error = as.character(obj$error_message),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

if (length(aic_weights_list) > 0) {

  aic_weights_df <- do.call(rbind, aic_weights_list)
  aic_values_df <- do.call(rbind, aic_values_list)
  model_status_df <- do.call(rbind, status_list)

  saveRDS(
    aic_weights_df,
    "aic_weights_perturbed_final.rds"
  )

  write.csv(
    aic_weights_df,
    "aic_weights_perturbed_final.csv",
    row.names = TRUE
  )

  saveRDS(
    aic_values_df,
    "aic_values_perturbed_final.rds"
  )

  write.csv(
    aic_values_df,
    "aic_values_perturbed_final.csv",
    row.names = TRUE
  )

  saveRDS(
    model_status_df,
    "aic_model_status_perturbed_final.rds"
  )

  write.csv(
    model_status_df,
    "aic_model_status_perturbed_final.csv",
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  cat("All done.\n")
  cat("Final AIC weights saved to 'aic_weights_perturbed_final.csv'.\n")
  cat("Model status saved to 'aic_model_status_perturbed_final.csv'.\n")

} else {

  cat("No results found to merge.\n")
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

results_dir <- "aic_results_per_compound_perturbed"

models <- c(
  "BM", "OU", "EB",
  "JN", "NIG", "VG",
  "BMJN", "BMNIG", "BMVG"
)

calc_aic_weights <- function(aic_values) {
  aic_values <- aic_values[models]
  names(aic_values) <- models

  w <- setNames(rep(0, length(models)), models)

  valid <- is.finite(aic_values)

  if (!any(valid)) {
    return(w)
  }

  aic_valid <- aic_values[valid]

  delta_aic <- aic_valid - min(aic_valid)

  weights_valid <- exp(-0.5 * delta_aic)
  weights_valid <- weights_valid / sum(weights_valid)

  w[names(weights_valid)] <- weights_valid

  return(w)
}

rds_files <- list.files(
  results_dir,
  pattern = "^aic_.*\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Number of RDS files found:", length(rds_files), "\n")

wAIC_list <- list()
AIC_list <- list()

for (f in rds_files) {

  obj <- readRDS(f)

  if (is.list(obj) && !is.null(obj$aic)) {

    compound_name <- obj$compound
    aic_values <- obj$aic

    aic_full <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(models)), models)
    matched_models <- intersect(names(aic_values), models)
    aic_full[matched_models] <- as.numeric(aic_values[matched_models])

    wAIC_values <- calc_aic_weights(aic_full)

  } else if (is.numeric(obj) && !is.null(names(obj))) {

    file_base <- basename(f)
    compound_name <- gsub("^aic_|\\.rds$", "", file_base)

    wAIC_values <- setNames(rep(0, length(models)), models)
    matched_models <- intersect(names(obj), models)
    wAIC_values[matched_models] <- as.numeric(obj[matched_models])

    aic_full <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(models)), models)

  } else {

    warning("Unrecognized RDS structure, skipped: ", f)
    next
  }

  if (is.null(compound_name) || is.na(compound_name) || compound_name == "") {
    compound_name <- gsub("^aic_|\\.rds$", "", basename(f))
  }

  wAIC_list[[compound_name]] <- wAIC_values
  AIC_list[[compound_name]] <- aic_full
}

wAIC_df <- do.call(rbind, wAIC_list)
AIC_df <- do.call(rbind, AIC_list)

wAIC_df <- as.data.frame(wAIC_df)
AIC_df <- as.data.frame(AIC_df)

wAIC_df <- wAIC_df[, models, drop = FALSE]
AIC_df <- AIC_df[, models, drop = FALSE]

write.csv(
  wAIC_df,
  "wAIC_perturbed_by_compound.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)

saveRDS(
  wAIC_df,
  "wAIC_perturbed_by_compound.rds"
)

write.csv(
  AIC_df,
  "AIC_perturbed_by_compound.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)

saveRDS(
  AIC_df,
  "AIC_perturbed_by_compound.rds"
)

cat("Done.\n")
cat("wAIC table saved to: wAIC_perturbed_by_compound.csv\n")
cat("AIC table saved to: AIC_perturbed_by_compound.csv\n")
```


```{r}
df_pert <- read.csv(
  "wAIC_perturbed_by_compound.csv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

col_sums_pert <- df_pert %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Model",
    values_to = "Total_Sum"
  )

col_sums_pert <- col_sums_pert %>%
  mutate(
    Normalized_Value = Total_Sum / sum(Total_Sum)
  )


model_order <- c(
  "BM", "OU", "EB",
  "JN", "NIG", "VG",
  "BMJN", "BMNIG", "BMVG"
)

col_sums_pert <- col_sums_pert %>%
  mutate(
    Model = factor(Model, levels = model_order)
  )


p_pert <- ggplot(
  col_sums_pert,
  aes(x = Model, y = Normalized_Value)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightgray") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(Normalized_Value, 3)),
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Model",
    y = "Proportion of Model Support") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black")
  )

print(p_pert)
```
